args.content:
Catalog: HR Coil (42k/10t), TMT Bars Fe500 (38k/10t), Steel Angles (36k/5t), MS Plates (40k/10t), Wire Rods (41k/10t). Pan-India 7-14d, bulk >100t.
Targets: Acme Steel (Mfg, Pune), Beta Build (Const, Mumbai), Gamma Infra (Const, Delhi), Delta Metals (Mfg, Chennai), Epsilon Projects (Const, Bangalore), Zeta Fabrication (Mfg, Ahmedabad).

# Steel Broker Lead Scoring & Rationale

| Priority | Company | Industry | City | Contact | Recommended Products | Rationale |
| :---: | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **1** | **Gamma Infra** | Construction | Delhi | Amit Verma | TMT Bars (Fe500), Steel Angles, MS Plates | Large-scale infrastructure projects in the capital region require massive and continuous supplies of TMT Bars and structural steel (MS Plates/Angles). High-volume potential with pan-India delivery (7-14 days). |
| **2** | **Beta Build** | Construction | Mumbai | Priya Mehta | TMT Bars (Fe500), Steel Angles | Commercial and residential construction boom in Mumbai hub. High demand for TMT bars and angles with reliable 7-14 day pan-India logistics. |
| **3** | **Epsilon Projects** | Construction | Bangalore | Kavita | TMT Bars (Fe500), MS Plates | Active real estate and civil projects in Bangalore. Excellent candidate for regular TMT bar orders and structural MS plates, benefiting from bulk discounts above 100 tons. |
| **4** | **Acme Steel** | Manufacturing | Pune | Raj Sharma | HR Coil, MS Plates, Wire Rods | Pune automotive and industrial manufacturing cluster. Requires high-quality HR Coils and MS Plates for fabrication and processing. |
| **5** | **Delta Metals** | Manufacturing | Chennai | Suresh | HR Coil, Wire Rods, Steel Angles | Southern industrial hub in Chennai. Steady need for HR Coils and Wire Rods for secondary manufacturing and wire drawing/fastener production. |
| **5** | **Zeta Fabrication** | Manufacturing | Ahmedabad | Rahul | Steel Angles, MS Plates, HR Coil | Gujarat manufacturing/fabrication sector requires durable MS Plates, Steel Angles, and HR Coils for structural frameworks and heavy machinery assembly. |
